Ratio Simplifier

Simplify any ratio to its lowest terms. Enter two or three numbers and get the reduced ratio, the greatest common divisor and each part's share of the whole.

Enter at least two numbers to simplify the ratio.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the first and second numbers of your ratio.
  2. Optionally add a third number for a three-part ratio.
  3. The simplified ratio appears instantly, reduced by the greatest common divisor.
  4. Use the table to see each part's simplified value and its percentage of the whole.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is a ratio simplified?

Every number in the ratio is divided by the greatest common divisor (GCD) of all the numbers. For example, 12:18:30 has a GCD of 6, so it simplifies to 2:3:5.

Can I simplify ratios with decimals?

Yes. Decimal inputs are scaled up to whole numbers first (for example 1.5:2.5 becomes 15:25) and then reduced, giving 3:5.

What does each part's percentage mean?

It is the simplified part divided by the total of the simplified parts. In 2:3:5 the first part is 2/10 = 20% of the whole.
